items.title: 1.7 Modulus Function and Its Graph (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Is topic mein ek bohat seedha lekin bohat kaam ka function seekhenge: modulus function. Aap ne pehle classes mein \(|{-5}| = 5\) jaisi cheezein dekhi hongi. Aaj hum isay function ki tarah dekhenge aur us ka graph banayenge, jo angrezi harf V jaisa dikhta hai.
Kitab ki definition: modulus function ya absolute value function (mutlaq qeemat ka function) ko is tarah likha aur define kiya jata hai:

blocks.text_alt: f of x equals modulus of x, which is x when x is greater than or equal to 0, and minus x when x is less than 0

blocks.text: Is ka matlab: agar \(x\) zero ya positive hai to us ko waisa hi rehne do; agar negative hai to us ke aage minus laga do, jis se woh positive ban jaye. Kitab ki misaalein: agar \(x = 2 > 0\) to \(|x| = |2| = 2\). Agar \(x = -2 < 0\) to \(|x| = |-2| = -(-2) = 2\). Isi tarah \(x = 0\) ho to \(|x| = |0| = 0\). Is liye kisi number ka modulus hamesha non-negative (yani zero ya positive) hota hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Bohat se students \(|x| = -x\) dekh kar ghabra jate hain ke modulus negative kaise ho gaya. Lekin yeh rule sirf \(x < 0\) ke liye hai. Agar \(x\) khud negative hai to \(-x\) positive hota hai: \(-(-2) = 2\). Do minus mil kar plus.
Aasan tasawwur: \(|x|\) number line par \(x\) ka zero se faasla (distance) hai. Faasla kabhi negative nahi hota. Ghar se school 2 km aage ho ya 2 km peechhe, faasla 2 km hi hai. Isi tarah \(-2\) aur \(2\) dono zero se 2 units door hain.
Khud sochiye: \(|-7|\), \(|7|\) aur \(|0|\) kitne hain? (Jawab: 7, 7, 0.)

Ab graph. Modulus function ka graph V ki shakal ka hai. Yeh do seedhi lines se banta hai jo origin par milti hain. \(x \ge 0\) ke liye graph line \(y = x\) hai, aur \(x < 0\) ke liye graph line \(y = -x\) hai. Is tarah modulus function ka graph points \((0, 0)\), \((2, 2)\) aur \((-2, 2)\) le kar banaya ja sakta hai, jaisa Figure 1.12 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Grid graph on a pale yellow panel, x from minus 4 to 5 and y from 0 to 6, labelled f(x) = |x|. Two blue rays with arrows form a V with its corner at the origin. The dots (minus 2, 2), (2, 2) and (0, 0) are marked; a small arrow points to (0, 0).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Graph se kya kya pata chalta hai (hamara khulasa):
1. Domain \(\mathbb{R}\) (har real number), range \([0, \infty[\): graph kabhi \(x\)-axis se neeche nahi jata, kyun ke modulus negative nahi hota.
2. Graph \(y\)-axis ke dono taraf bilkul ek jaisa hai (symmetric), kyun ke \(|-x| = |x|\). Table mein dekhiye: \(-3\) aur \(3\) dono par value 3.
3. Sab se neecha point (vertex) origin \((0, 0)\) hai; wahan graph ka nukeela kona (sharp corner) hai.
4. Graph continuous hai: dono lines origin par mil jati hain, koi khaali jagah nahi.
5. Yeh one-to-one nahi, kyun ke \(|-2| = |2| = 2\); horizontal line \(y = 2\) graph ko do jagah kaat-ti hai. Yeh baat agle topic 1.8 mein kaam aayegi.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(x \ge 0\) par \(|x| = x\), aur \(x < 0\) par \(|x| = -x\).
2. Har real \(x\) ke liye \(|x| \ge 0\).
3. Graph V hai: baayen \(y = -x\), daayen \(y = x\), vertex \((0, 0)\).
4. Sketch ke liye teen points kaafi hain: \((-2, 2)\), \((0, 0)\), \((2, 2)\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(|x| = -x\) ko 'modulus negative hai' samajhna. \(x < 0\) par \(-x\) positive hai.
2. Baayen baazu ko \(x\)-axis se neeche banana; woh \(y = x\) ka graph hai, \(|x|\) ka nahi.
3. Origin par kone ko gol (curve) bana dena; dono baazu seedhi lines hain.
